cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Take My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into your interpretation of a conflict involving a shared relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You're Alex's friend too. Tell him alternating weekends at the allotment was a fair compromise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We agreed all three of us would go every Saturday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then help him see my version as sharing the workload.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll talk to him, but you have to admit you changed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I will. Could you explain that I changed the rota because I want us to stay friends?

mechanism: A copies a misunderstood conciliatory practice and recruits B to explain a shared conflict in A preferred terms.
confusable: D75 seeks understanding from the person involved; D79 enlists someone in interpreting a conflict involving a third shared relationship.
comparison: Family holiday blame versus friends sharing allotment weekends.
seedUse: Retain B insistence on whole truth and admitted change as constraints on A preferred framing.
